findingDetails.title: The rewritten comment defines a shared suffix rule that no suffix test pins, and the documented :with-phases modifier has no positive case
findingDetails.scopeProof: The suffix tests are the only guard for MODE_SUFFIX; a grep of tests/ finds no :with-phases case and no :with-* case on a command that does not advertise it
findingDetails.case: A maintainer derives the suffix set per command from argument-hint and drops phases: /speckit:plan:with-phases add a login page, documented at plan.md:3, stops reading as /speckit:plan while every suffix test stays green because no test types :with-phases.

ruledOut: the comment being inaccurate after the pass-seven rewrite
a test that asserts the wrong command for a suffix input

results.summary: AC-003 inputs and both refusals are pinned; the shared-rule sentence and :with-phases sit outside AC-003 and are recorded as the P2 matrix gap
Phase-parent packet has no checklist.md; the pass-eight brief and scope file are the operative checklist

noveltyJustification: One new P2: the pass-seven remediation changed the comment to state a shared rule but did not add the :with-phases case its own plan seed asked for, so the rule has no test guard. The finding is new to this pass because the comment rewrite makes the shared rule a stated contract.
